description:
“It wasn't pathetic at all, Haesu.”

Taeyoung’s hand cupping her cheek was large and warm. Tears welled up in an instant.

“Huh?”

Before she could even process her own state, tears spilled over. Taeyoung stood up and pulled Haesu into an embrace.   
Soon, Haesu’s shoulders began to tremble.

“Goo Minjun, you jerk. Waaaaah……”

Haesu hugged him back. Bursting into tears like a child, she buried her face in his stomach and clutched his clothes as if clinging to his waist. Taeyoung simply stroked her hair soothingly so she could cry comfortably.   
The crying continued for a while. 

“What should I do to stop Haesu from crying?”   
“Waaaaah, I don't know, they keep—hic!—coming, what am I supposed to do…?”  
“Should we get revenge on Goo Minjun?”  
“Revenge……?”
